items.title: Can Doximity Keep Shrinking Its Share Count Through Its AI Investment Year?
items.summary: Doximity (DOCS), which calls itself the leading digital platform for U.S. medical professionals, has seen its stock fall steeply over the past year. Even after a rise over the past three months, the shares sit about 65% below their 52-week high. Management continued its repurchase program, allocating approximately $401 million over the latest twelve months. The test is whether it can keep that up through what it calls its AI investment year.
